messages:
Noah Simms: Hey team — I'm starting today! I'm Noah (SRE -> infra distro). Quick q's: who should I ping for VPN access? My laptop MDM install is stuck at 'Waiting for device' during enrollment. Any tips? Fun fact: I collect sneakers — current fave is Nike SB Dunk High :sneaker: Looking forward to meeting y'all!

Claire (People Ops): Welcome Noah!! :tada: Quick heads up — orientation at 10:30 in #all-hands, badge and welcome kit on the way. If you haven't filled the onboarding form let me know and I'll DM it. Also we do a quick intro in tomorrow's standup :slightly_smiling_face:

Aisha Patel: welcome!! I can take the MDM stuff. What model laptop is it and are you on macOS or Win? For macs you can check enrollment status with:
```
profiles status -type enrollment
```
If the above shows 'Waiting for device' reply here and I'll remote in. For Okta/ssh keys, ping me and I'll add you to the infra team group.

Marco Diaz: Hey @Noah — for VPN, open a support ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue! Use template below and tag eng-infra. Example body:
```
Summary: VPN access for Noah Simms
Account: noah.simms@redwood.com
Reason: SRE infra onboarding
Required by: ASAP
```
I'll watch the ticket and approve. Also if you need access to the dedicated cluster, say so in the ticket.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist for Noah Simms:
- [x] Welcome email sent
- [ ] Laptop MDM enrollment
- [ ] Okta groups added
- [ ] VPN access requested
- [ ] Intro in team standup

Noah Simms: Thanks everyone — filling the ticket now @Marco and attaching laptop model. Appreciate the quick responses :raised_hands:
